√dhan 'run'
[present: [3.] dadhanti -- [1.] dhanati ]
perfect: dadhánat 
secondary: causative: dhanáyan dhanáyante dhanáyanta 
derivatives: dhániṣṭha 
Compare roots dhanv, dhav, dhāv, dhū.

√dhanv 'run'
present: [1.] dhánvati etc. dhaniva 
perfect: dadhanvé dadhanviré 
aorist: [5.] ádhanviṣus 
derivatives: dhánutṛ 
Seems to be a secondary root-form, from the preceding. Its v has value as u in half the RV. cases (in the present-system).
